DALI ERROR_REPORTING SET_MODE: 101-Help: Sets the mode for error reporting.
101-Help: For static Error Reporting mode => set this to the desired mode and ensure
101-Help: Error Reporting Enable Group is set to Unused (0xFF).
101-Help: For Dynamic Error Reporting => set Error Reporting Enable Group to a value other than 0xFF.
101-Help: Then the value stored here is the Power On value for the Error Reporting.
101-Help: In dynamic mode, the error mode is controlled by the level of the Enable Group.
101-Help: If level store option is enabled => treat this value as read-only.
101-Help: Current level at power fail is stored here.
101-Help: If level store option is not enabled => this is the power-on mode value.

101-Help: <error-mode> refers to the selected Error Reporting mode

DALI GATEWAY VIRTUAL_GROUP: 101-Help: Gets members of virtual group @ specified line via a bitmask of object ids
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <virtual-group-id> refers to virtual dali group in gateway
101-Help: <bitmask64> refers to the hex 64 bit - mask of dali devices included in virtual group
101-Help:             NOTE : Bit position is by Object ID, NOT Short Address
DALI GATEWAY WRITE_EXTENDED_PARAMETERS: 101-Help: Write dirty extended parameter map for gateway.
101 Help: NOTE: writes may be slower if read_extended_parameters is not run prior.
DALI GTIN: 101-Help: Returns stored GTIN for addressed ECG.
101-Help: NOTE: requires `dali discover_gtin_serial` to be run
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI KNOWN: 101-Help: Will initiate search for new addresses not known by CDG.
101-Help: Execution of command is non-destructive & non-remediating.
101-Help: note: poll - will not initiate a refresh
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101 Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI KNOWN_TYPE_INFO: 101-Help: Retrieves list of device types present at the addressed ECG.
101-Help: NOTE: this should be used after `dali discover_known_type_info`
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI LED_PARAMS: 101-Help: Gets ONLY for DT6 LED params (207) for addressed ECG.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI MEASUREMENT: 101-Help:  DALI MEASUREMENT ? Help for these commands
101-Help:  DALI MEASUREMENT CLEAR_TRIGGER_GROUP - Get measurement clear trigger group.
101-Help:  DALI MEASUREMENT LAMP_RUNNING_TIME - Get lamp running time for device.
101-Help:  DALI MEASUREMENT REQUEST_TRIGGER_GROUP - Get measurement request trigger group.
101-Help:  DALI MEASUREMENT SET_CLEAR_TRIGGER_GROUP - Set measurement clear trigger group.
101-Help:  DALI MEASUREMENT SET_LAMP_RUNNING_TIME - Set lamp running time for device.
101 Help:  DALI MEASUREMENT SET_REQUEST_TRIGGER_GROUP - Set measurement request trigger group.
DALI MEASUREMENT CLEAR_TRIGGER_GROUP: 101-Help: Gets the trigger group used to clear lamp hour values.
101-Help: Level sent on group determines type of request.
101-Help: Lamp is addressed by Object ID not SA
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <clear-trigger-group> refers to Trigger Group for clearing lamp hour values.
DALI MEASUREMENT LAMP_RUNNING_TIME: 101-Help: Gets the lamp running time for Short Address @ specified line
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <short-address-lamp> refers to specified lamp at Short Address for dali lines
101-Help: <running-time32> refers to the hex 32 bit - Lamp running time in minutes
DALI MEASUREMENT REQUEST_TRIGGER_GROUP: 101-Help: Gets the trigger group used to request measurements.
101-Help: Level sent on group determines type of request.
101-Help: Lamp is addressed by Object ID not SA
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <request-trigger-group> refers to Trigger Group for requesting broadcast of lamp hour
101-Help:              and other measurement values on Measurement Application.
DALI MEASUREMENT SET_CLEAR_TRIGGER_GROUP: 101-Help: Sets the trigger group used to clear lamp hour values.
101-Help: Level sent on group determines type of request.
101-Help: Lamp is addressed by Object ID not SA
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <clear-trigger-group> refers to Trigger Group for clearing lamp hour values.
DALI MEASUREMENT SET_LAMP_RUNNING_TIME: 101-Help: Sets lamp running time for Short Address @ specified line
101-Help: note: you might have to save_to_nvm or wait for this number to update.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <short-address-lamp> refers to specified lamp at Short Address for dali lines
101-Help: <running-time32> refers to the hex 32 bit - Lamp running time in minutes
DALI MEASUREMENT SET_REQUEST_TRIGGER_GRO: 101-Help: Sets the trigger group used to request measurements.
101-Help: Level sent on group determines type of request.
101-Help: Lamp is addressed by Object ID not SA
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <request-trigger-group> refers to Trigger Group for requesting broadcast of lamp hour
101-Help:              and other measurement values on Measurement Application.
DALI MISSING: 101-Help: Will initiate search for missing addresses by CDG.
101-Help: Execution of command is non-destructive & non-remediating.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101 Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI REASSIGN_ONE: 101-Help: Change short address of ECG device to the newly specified value.
101-Help: Can be used to unassign, new address must be vacant to succeed.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <ecg-address-xxx> refers to short address of device (existing / new)
DALI RECALL_MAX: 101-Help: Send a Recall MAX command to the addressed ECG.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: [ecg-address=($50)] refers to short address, broadcast address or group address
DALI RECALL_MAX_MANY: 101-Help: Send a Recall MAX command to the addressed ECG via mask.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <selected-addresses> refers to the 64 bit - bitmask - of short address to turn ON
101 Help:           assumes a hexstring of 16 string characters long.
DALI RECALL_MIN: 101-Help: Send a Recall MIN command to the addressed ECG.
101-Help: NOTE: effectively equal to DIMMEST / LOWEST setting
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: [ecg-address=($50)] refers to short address, broadcast address or group address
DALI RECALL_OFF: 101-Help: Send an OFF command to the addressed ECG.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: [ecg-address=($50)] refers to short address, broadcast address or group address
DALI RECALL_OFF_MANY: 101-Help: Send an OFF command to the addressed ECG addresses via mask.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <selected-addresses> refers to the 64 bit - bitmask - of short address to turn OFF
101 Help:           assumes a hexstring of 16 string characters long.
DALI REMOVE_GROUP_MANY: 101-Help: Removes the Group Membership for specified devices.
101-Help: note: will still keep previously defined group memberships.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <group-num> Group number to remove from the selected devices.
101 Help: <bitmask64> refers to selected short addresses as 64bit bitmask
DALI REMOVE_MANY: 101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <remove-addresses> refers to the 64 bit - bitmask - of short address for removal
101 Help:         assumes a hexstring of 16 string characters long.
DALI REPLACE_BAD: 101-Help: Change short address of *BAD* ECG device to the newly specified value.
101-Help: BAD = broken or missing device, existing device must be recognised as missing for success.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: <ecg-address-xxx> refers to short address of device (existing / new)
DALI RESCAN: 101-Help: Will initiate full discovery scan by CDG.
101-Help: Will search for unaddressed, broken, missing & conflicting devices.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101 Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI SCENE_VALUES_HIGH: 101-Help: Retrieves the scene values of the addressed ECG.
101-Help: NOTE: levels for scenes 8-15 (valid range $00 to $FE, $FF=unset)
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: <ecg-address> refers to short address of existing device
DALI SCENE_VALUES_LOW: 101-Help: Retrieves the scene values of the addressed ECG.
101-Help: NOTE: levels for scenes 0-7 (valid range $00 to $FE, $FF=unset)
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: <ecg-address> refers to short address of existing device
DALI SERIAL: 101-Help: Returns stored Serial Number for addressed ECG.
101-Help: NOTE: requires `dali discover_gtin_serial` to be run
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI SESSION: 101-Help:  DALI SESSION ? Help for these commands
101-Help:  DALI SESSION CATALOG_DEVICE_ADD - Creates new instance of dali catalogue device
101-Help:  DALI SESSION CATALOG_DEVICE_REMOVE - Removes instance of dali catalogue device
101-Help:  DALI SESSION DEPLOY - Deploy DALI parameters to CDG specified.
101-Help:  DALI SESSION END - Ends an existing DALI session
101-Help:  DALI SESSION EXTRACT - Extracts DALI parameters from CDG specified.
101-Help:  DALI SESSION GET - Get PARAMS from DALI session
101-Help:  DALI SESSION LIST - Lists all active DALI session names
101-Help:  DALI SESSION LOAD - Load DALI parameters to session for database unit specified.
101-Help:  DALI SESSION MULTIGET - MultiGet PARAMS from DALI session
101-Help:  DALI SESSION NEW - Create a new DALI session
101-Help:  DALI SESSION SAVE - Save DALI parameters to database unit specified.
101-Help:  DALI SESSION SET - Set PARAMS in DALI session
101 Help:  DALI SESSION SET_EXT_PARAMS - Set extended parameter values in programmer virtual memory.
DALI SESSION CATALOG_DEVICE_ADD: 101-Help: creates a new instance of specified dali catalogue device type.
101-Help: it will create in dali catalogue model of session specified, and on the line specified
101-Help: it will attempt to also place at specified OID. if -1 or empty attempts to find next free spot.
101-Help: NOTE: there is no guarantee that channel OIDs are going to be sequential.
101-Help: <session-name> any name that is currently active. no spaces allowed
101-Help: <dc-device-name> must exist in `dali catalog list` command
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: [dali-OID] refers to desired dali OID. default is -1, which creates at next free OID
DALI SESSION CATALOG_DEVICE_REMOVE: 101-Help: removes an existing instance of dali catalogue device.
101-Help: will remove specified dali catalogue device and all its channels.
101-Help: <session-name> any name that is currently active. no spaces allowed
101 Help: <session-OID> refers to session OID assigned to dali catalogue device
DALI SESSION DEPLOY: 101-Help: deploy DALI parameters from specified session to live CDG.
101-Help: will use plan indicated by deploy type for the address range specified
101-Help:        (Anything apart from A,B will get interpreted as BOTH)
101-Help:        (Ascending order of estimated time till complete)
101-Help: [ecg-address-range] if empty will assume full ecg range.
101-Help:        will accept specified short address separated by commas
101-Help:        e.g. 0,5,2,4 => will only scan subset if applicable
101 Help:        note: ext_params only respects the changed parameter set
DALI SESSION END: 101-Help: ends an existing DALI session with specified name.
101-Help: note: end means remove from active sesssions list
101 Help: <session-name> any name that is currently active. no spaces allowed
DALI SESSION EXTRACT: 101-Help: extracts DALI parameters into specified session from live CDG.
101-Help: will use plan indicated by extract type for the address range specified
101-Help:        (Anything apart from A,B will get interpreted as BOTH)
101-Help: [ecg-address-range] if empty will assume full ecg range.
101-Help:        will accept specified short address separated by commas
101-Help:        e.g. 0,5,2,4 => will only scan subset if applicable
101 Help:        note: group, virtualgroup oids will also be subsetted.
DALI SESSION GET: 101-Help: Get PARAMs from DALI session for model-path specified.
101-Help: <session-name> any name that is currently active. no spaces allowed
101 Help:              beware it expects cgate style enquoted string
DALI SESSION LIST: 101 Help: Lists all active DALI session names.
DALI SESSION LOAD: 101-Help: load DALI parameters from sqlite db to specified session for database CDG unit.
101 Help: <db-cdg> must exist and match SYS_DAL2 type. OID will also work.
DALI SESSION MULTIGET: 101-Help: MultiGet PARAMs from DALI session for model-path specified.
101-Help: <session-name> any name that is currently active. no spaces allowed
101 Help:              beware it expects cgate style enquoted string
DALI SESSION NEW: 101-Help: creates a new active DALI session with specified name.
101-Help: if project not specified will attemt to load default project.
101-Help: used for LOAD/SAVE models & GET/SET parameters, for a CbusDaliGateway.
101-Help: <session-name> any name that is currently not in use. no spaces allowed
101 Help: [project-name] any project that is loadable. if blank, will attempt to load default project
DALI SESSION SAVE: 101-Help: save DALI parameters from specified session to database CDG unit.
101 Help: <db-cdg> must exist and match SYS_DAL2 type. OID will also work.
DALI SESSION SET: 101-Help: Set PARAMs in DALI session for model-path specified.
101-Help: <session-name> any name that is currently active. no spaces allowed
101-Help:              beware it expects cgate style enquoted string
101 Help: <model-json> parameter value in json, beware wrapped around in cgate style enquoted string
DALI SESSION SET_EXT_PARAMS: 101-Help: Set extended parameters from startaddress for supplied number of bytes.
101-Help: NOTE: this will NOT write to the gateway immediately
101-Help:       send 'deploy' after all the sets, when ready
101-Help: max 16 bytes at once for now
101 Help: <session-name> any name that is currently active. no spaces allowed
DALI SET_COLOUR_POWER_FAIL_PARAMS: 101-Help: Retrieves colour power on / system failure params for DT8 @ the addressed ECG.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI SET_COLOUR_TEMPERATURE: 101-Help: Set Colour Temperature limits for specified DT8 @ the addressed ECG.
101-Help: NOTE: try to keep temp divisible by 50K. use physical limits for min/max
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI SET_COMMON_PARAMS: 101-Help: Add or remove devices to scene and set the scene level.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <rec> poweron/recovery level. ($FF = restore to last active level)
101 Help: <fail> system failure level. ($FF = stay at current level)
DALI SET_FAILURE_MANY: 101-Help: Sets the Failure Value for specified devices.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <failure-level> refers to value to be configured
101 Help: <bitmask64> refers to selected short addresses as 64bit bitmask
DALI SET_GROUP_MANY: 101-Help: Adds the Group Membership for specified devices.
101-Help: note: will still keep previously defined group memberships.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <group-num> Group number that will be assigned to the selected devices
101 Help: <bitmask64> refers to selected short addresses as 64bit bitmask
DALI SET_LED_PARAMS: 101-Help: Set LED dimming curve for the specified device (DT6).
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI SET_MAX_MANY: 101-Help: Sets the Max Value for specified devices.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <max-value> refers to value to be configured
101-Help:    (must be greater than the min level)
101 Help: <bitmask64> refers to selected short addresses as 64bit bitmask
DALI SET_MIN_MANY: 101-Help: Sets the Min Value for specified devices.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <min-value> refers to value to be configured
101-Help:    (must be greater than or equal to the physical min, and less than the max level)
101 Help: <bitmask64> refers to selected short addresses as 64bit bitmask
DALI SET_RECOVERY_MANY: 101-Help: Sets the recovery Value for specified devices.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <recovery-value> refers to value to be configured
101-Help:     (Valid range $00 to $FF ($FF = go to last active level))
101 Help: <bitmask64> refers to selected short addresses as 64bit bitmask
DALI SET_SCENE_LEVEL_MANY: 101-Help: Add or remove devices to scene and set the scene level.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <scene-num> Scene number to set the level for in the selected devices (0-15)
101-Help: <scene-level> New scene level to store. Setting level of $FF clears scene membership.
101 Help: <bitmask64> refers to short address, broadcast address or group address
DALI SET_SCENE_VALUES_HIGH: 101-Help: Sets the scene values and membership for scenes 9 to 16 for specified device.
101-Help: Can be used to unassign by $FF
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <ecg-address> refers to short address, group address, or broadcast address
101 Help: <scene-level-64> levels for scenes 9-16 (valid range $00 to $FE, $FF clears scene membership.)
DALI SET_SCENE_VALUES_LOW: 101-Help: Sets the scene values and membership for scenes 1 to 8 for specified device.
101-Help: Can be used to unassign by $FF
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: <ecg-address> refers to short address, group address, or broadcast address
101 Help: <scene-level-64> levels for scenes 1-8 (valid range $00 to $FE, $FF clears scene membership.)
DALI SWAP_TWO: 101-Help: Swap short address between two existing ECG devices.
101-Help: note: requires at least one free short address
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101 Help: <ecg-address-xxx> refers to short address of existing device
DALI TRIGGER_SCENE: 101-Help: Trigger specified scene on the addressed ECG device.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: [ecg-address=($50)] refers to short address of existing device
101 Help: [scene-num=($00)] refers to the scene number to be set on the device
DALI WINK_ECG_OFF: 101-Help: Stops all winks that are already running on specified line.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101 Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
DALI WINK_ECG_ON: 101-Help: Starts winking the ECG device specified.
101-Help: The wink process will stop after the specified timeout (in seconds).
101-Help: Normally used for identifying a device (via binary search addressing)
101-Help: but can also be used on the broadcast address as a basic test for device operation.
101-Help: <cdg-object-id> must be of type CDG (CBus DALI Gateway).
101-Help: <line> refers to dali line A or B.
101-Help: [ecg-address=($50)] refers to short address or broadcast address (group wink not supported)
101 Help: [timeout=($FF)] refers to timeout used in seconds. 0=(default-dali ~30s)
